capabilities: Search medical reference images for selected or entered text
Filter results by category such as atlas, radiology, histology, and clinical
Copy result images to the clipboard for pasting into notes or other apps
Download images into vault attachments and insert embeds under the selected text
Preview full-size images in a docked sidebar with a zoomable modal
extras: Windows-only plugin. README warns not to search confidential patient information, notes that result images remain under their original licenses, and that provider quotas and charges may change.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search the web for reference images matching selected text and insert them directly while writing.

relations.evidence: Uses DuckDuckGo Image Search by default — no API keys, accounts, or subscriptions needed.
Wikimedia Commons: Images from Wikimedia Commons; check each image license.
Google Custom Search Engine (CSE): Optional Google Cloud API Key + Search Engine ID
Google Images via SerpApi: Optional SerpApi key for direct Google Images scraping results.
Brave Search API: Optional Brave Image search subscription token.

requires.name: Google Cloud API key and Search Engine ID, SerpApi key, or Brave Search token

summary: Finds medical reference images for selected note text via search providers, with sidebar previews, clipboard copy, and offline insertion into notes.
